name: timeline-strip
description: A bar along the top with marks and labels (years, eras) and a cursor that moves along it as the song goes, so every piece of the song shows where the song is; put it on any piece with `with`

params.name: labels
params.description: The marks, separated by |, spread evenly along the bar

params.name: progress
params.description: Where the cursor stays, in percent; -1 for the position of the song
